arguments.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# find_hosts.sh - list active IPv4 hosts in a subnet using a ping sweep.
#
# Usage:
#   ./find_hosts.sh                 # auto-detect default interface subnet
#   ./find_hosts.sh 192.168.1.0/24  # scan a specific CIDR
#
# Notes:
#   - Requires: bash, ping, ip (for auto-detection only)
#   - Intended for networks you own or are authorized to scan.

usage() {
  cat <<'USAGE'
Usage: ./find_hosts.sh [CIDR]

Examples:
  ./find_hosts.sh
  ./find_hosts.sh 192.168.1.0/24

Lists active IPv4 addresses by sending one ICMP echo request to each host.
USAGE
}

err() {
  printf 'Error: %s\n' "$*" >&2
  exit 1
}

require_cmd() {
  command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || err "required command not found: $1"
}

ip_to_int() {
  local a b c d
  IFS=. read -r a b c d <<<"$1"
  printf '%u\n' $(( (a << 24) + (b << 16) + (c << 8) + d ))
}

int_to_ip() {
  local ip_int=$1
  printf '%u.%u.%u.%u\n' \
    $(( (ip_int >> 24) & 255 )) \
    $(( (ip_int >> 16) & 255 )) \
    $(( (ip_int >> 8) & 255 )) \
    $(( ip_int & 255 ))
}

valid_ipv4() {
  local ip=$1 octet
  [[ $ip =~ ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}$ ]] || return 1
  IFS=. read -ra octets <<<"$ip"
  for octet in "${octets[@]}"; do
    (( octet >= 0 && octet <= 255 )) || return 1
  done
}

cidr_hosts() {
  local cidr=$1 ip prefix ip_int mask network broadcast first last current

  [[ $cidr == */* ]] || err "CIDR must look like 192.168.1.0/24"
  ip=${cidr%/*}
  prefix=${cidr#*/}

  valid_ipv4 "$ip" || err "invalid IPv4 address: $ip"
  [[ $prefix =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || err "invalid CIDR prefix: $prefix"
  (( prefix >= 1 && prefix <= 32 )) || err "CIDR prefix must be between 1 and 32"

  ip_int=$(ip_to_int "$ip")
  if (( prefix == 32 )); then
    printf '%s\n' "$ip"
    return
  fi

  mask=$(( (0xffffffff << (32 - prefix)) & 0xffffffff ))
  network=$(( ip_int & mask ))
  broadcast=$(( network | (~mask & 0xffffffff) ))

  if (( prefix == 31 )); then
    first=$network
    last=$broadcast
  else
    first=$(( network + 1 ))
    last=$(( broadcast - 1 ))
  fi

  for (( current = first; current <= last; current++ )); do
    int_to_ip "$current"
  done
}

auto_detect_cidr() {
  require_cmd ip

  local iface cidr
  iface=$(ip route show default 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==1 {for (i=1; i<=NF; i++) if ($i=="dev") print $(i+1)}')
  [[ -n ${iface:-} ]] || err "could not detect default network interface; pass a CIDR manually"

  cidr=$(ip -o -4 addr show dev "$iface" scope global 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==1 {print $4}')
  [[ -n ${cidr:-} ]] || err "could not detect IPv4 subnet on $iface; pass a CIDR manually"

  printf '%s\n' "$cidr"
}

main() {
  if [[ ${1:-} == "-h" || ${1:-} == "--help" ]]; then
    usage
    exit 0
  fi

  require_cmd ping

  local cidr=${1:-} tmp active_count=0 max_jobs=64 ip
  if [[ -z $cidr ]]; then
    cidr=$(auto_detect_cidr)
    printf 'Auto-detected subnet: %s\n' "$cidr" >&2
  fi

  tmp=$(mktemp)
  trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT

  printf 'Active hosts in %s:\n' "$cidr"

  while IFS= read -r ip; do
    {
      if ping -c 1 -W 1 "$ip" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        printf '%s\n' "$ip" >>"$tmp"
      fi
    } &

    # Keep concurrency bounded.
    while (( $(jobs -rp | wc -l) >= max_jobs )); do
      wait -n || true
    done
  done < <(cidr_hosts "$cidr")

  wait || true

  if [[ -s $tmp ]]; then
    sort -V "$tmp"
    active_count=$(wc -l <"$tmp" | tr -d ' ')
  fi

  printf 'Found %s active host(s).\n' "$active_count" >&2
}

main "$@"

arguments.command:
mkdir -p .git/hooks && cat > .git/hooks/post-checkout <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Git post-checkout hook: run a local ping sweep after checkout.
# Arguments from Git: <old-ref> <new-ref> <flag>

set -u

repo_root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)
script="$repo_root/find_hosts.sh"

if [[ ! -x "$script" ]]; then
  printf '[post-checkout] Skipping host discovery: %s is missing or not executable.\n' "$script" >&2
  exit 0
fi

printf '[post-checkout] Running host discovery via find_hosts.sh...\n' >&2
"$script"
status=$?

if (( status != 0 )); then
  printf '[post-checkout] find_hosts.sh exited with status %s.\n' "$status" >&2
fi

# Do not block checkout success/failure based on host discovery.
exit 0
EOF
chmod +x .git/hooks/post-checkout
ls -l .git/hooks/post-checkout && bash -n .git/hooks/post-checkout
